meta.description:
A compact astronomical sanctuary arranged as a crooked circuit around a silent central observatory. Visitors enter through low, dark chambers before the
  plan opens into a luminous roofward gallery of instruments and ritual objects.

rooms.name: Ember Vestibule
rooms.style: A compressed arrival chamber with soot- black plaster, warm bronze superquadric benches, and a cluster of low lantern forms that make the room feel excavated from darkness.
